notes.title: Onwards
notes.content: [h3][b]Hey and hello![/b][/h3][p]Guess what - Crystals Of Irm is part of this year's “No Time to Loot” festival - woo-hoo! Feel free to check it out - there are lots of great games there.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/5658b60efd37de23d412a3fa95cc73beb1306df0.png"][/img][/p][p]Today's update will be a little shorter than usual because I've got my hands full right now. But despite all the tasks I have to do, I'm making good progress and the game is coming along nicely again.[/p][h3][b]Weekly Task[/b][/h3][p]As discussed last week, the new internal version is ready and I'm waiting for feedback on it. The newly implemented dialogue system and my cutscene system work wonderfully together and give me the opportunity to communicate the motivation or necessity of various quests much better! The demo update will give you a first little taste of this![/p][h3][b]Demo Stuff[/b][/h3][p]I'm currently in the final stages of completing the demo update. As already mentioned, some of the bugs you reported will be fixed, and Miris will be expanded to include the Adventurers' Guild. Here, you can accept quests that will take you to the labyrinth dungeons in Irm and also interact with other adventurers. I'm excited to hear what you think![/p][p]So that's it for this week's dev update! See you again next week.[/p][p]Until then,[/p][p]David ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p]

notes.title: New Chapter
notes.content: [h2]Hey and Hallo![/h2][p]Something fundamental has changed this week - I've made it and am now working full-time on Crystals Of Irm. It's been a wild ride to get here, and I'm really excited about this new chapter. It will also be really good for the game that I can now invest much more time in its development. A big thank you to everyone who has been with me this far.[/p][p]At this point, I would also like to say a big thank you to everyone who uses the feedback tool in the demo and shares their ideas with me, reports bugs, and actively helps me make the game better! Thank you! [/p][p]I have also decided to structure these weekly posts a little better. The idea is to use the beginning for general information - what's going on with me, what's happening, etc.[/p][p]This will be followed by a section on what I'll be working on during the week and finally a short section on planned demo updates. [/p][h3]Weekly Task[/h3][p]This week, the start of the full version will undergo another overhaul. The goal is to make the introduction to the combat system a little more relaxed and to introduce the story in an understandable way. It's going to be really good![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/ae37d019685859fd6bb503bf055d1835b06a4570.png"][/img][/p][h3]Demo Stuff[/h3][p]In the next demo update, we're saying goodbye to the input billboards that always seemed a bit out of place around the corresponding interactions and welcoming a dynamic cursor that is located in the center of the screen and indicates the corresponding interaction - it's about time![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="MELyZdC2QnM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]That's it for this week's update! If you have any questions or want to chat with me about the game, feel free to join the Discord Of Irm! Or if you want to give direct feedback on the game, check out the demo and use the feedback tool.[/p][p]See you next week![/p][p]David ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p]

notes.title: Gamescom roundup & What's Next
notes.content: [h3][b]Hey and Hallo![/b] [/h3][p]Gamescom is over, I'm back home, and what can I say - it was simply amazing! A huge thank you to everyone who stopped by the booth for all the kind words and great feedback. It was truly wonderful to meet you all!  [/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/08a981cd87de6dcf5ebe60a8f66bd1f028035b8b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/5f6efba860798148fa222833578cae77677349cb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/8e2e1d202ae76a20ac4c84498f479e52778067d6.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]Since I'm working on this game mostly on my own, it was really great to see that you enjoy Crystals Of Irm! The best part, though, was having the opportunity to talk to you a bit about your experiences. That was incredibly valuable, and I learned a lot.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/7ed94644db80f83a661270422c4838e6daedb1b0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The demo will remain online from now on and will be updated with new features and bug fixes. In addition, the feedback tool will remain active, allowing you to send me direct feedback or bug reports. This means that even after Gamescom, you can continue to explore Crystals Of Irm and actively participate in its development. This way, I want to stay in touch with you and discuss your feedback. In addition to the feedback tool in the demo, you can also come directly to [url="https://discord.gg/zYxNSK7a2n"]Discord [/url]and exchange ideas with me and others there! Your feedback and impressions are really helpful to me -and since I'm working on the game as a solo developer, they're one of the most important factors in making the game great![/p][p]For me, it's now straight back to work on Crystals Of Irm - I want to get the new update finished this week.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2209040/Crystals_Of_Irm_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Take care![/p][p]David ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: A Massive Demo Update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]With the Tiny Teams Event starting soon and [b]Crystals of Irm[/b] being a part of that, we thought it'd be about time to give you all a massive [i]PLAYABLE[/i] update. So here we are, announcing an all new Demo. A new Trailer is also in the works but that'll take slightly longer. Wished it was ready for today but hey, Gamescom is ahead so that's another chance, right?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/b7a2c356e4bc02c10c16b792cabb1e3bacc4e385.jpg"][/img][/p][p]What's new in the demo? Well. Uhm. Everything? If you ever played an earlier iteration of [b]Crystals of Irm[/b] you should completely wipe out that experience from your memory. We've been working on literally everything. While it is still the same game, it plays, feels and even looks different now. The style is the same but everything has been tuned, upgraded and tuned even further.[/p][p]From UI to Combat, from visuals to controls (they are not yet fully done though), from pixels to progression. Everything. Just literally everything has been worked on. And finally the project is in a state where we are very happy with it and from where we can now focus on creating more content and fill up the world with monsters, dungeons and NPCs.[/p][p][/p][p]So long![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2209040/Crystals_Of_Irm_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Lots Of UI
notes.content: [h3][b]Hey and Hallo![/b][/h3][p]A new week is about to start, so it’s time for a new dev update! The Crystals Of Irm demo is running quite smoothly, but a couple of minor issues have cropped up that need to be fixed today. Fingers crossed, these will be resolved today or tomorrow at the latest.[/p][p]To prepare you a little more for the demo, I want to show you the different user interfaces in the game. Above all, I want to show you what information the interface has in store for you in the different game states.[/p][p]The main UI, which you will see most of the time, looks like this.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/90a74a0c3eb70642cdad800fd07d8acfc7e1221b.png"][/img][/p][p]On the right side, you can see your three heroes. Below the portrait, you will find information about their current hit points, and next to that are the three stats STR, DEX, and INT. In the box at the bottom right, you will find your currently available gold and your rations, which you need to rest and flee from battles. Next to that, you will also find your available USE and SEARCH points. These resources are used, for example, to open paths or to perform interactions in points of interest on the overworld.[/p][p][/p][p]The battle UI provides a little more information and looks like this.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/d38e042af602b52a0e4bd4057d108c41384685e1.png"][/img][/p][p]As in the main interface, you will see your three heroes and their hit points on the right side. There is also another bar that indicates the hero's ATK value. The ATK value represents the steps you have to take before the hero throws their weapon token onto the field. Next to the portrait, you will see the hero's equipped skill and a smaller bar for the action points required to trigger the skill token. You get one action point for each filled ATK bar. When this action point bar is full, the hero throws their skill token onto the field.[/p][p]On the left side of the battle UI, you will find the enemy group. Each enemy has a hit point bar and a bar below it that shows when the next attack will be triggered. At the bottom, you will find a small log that gives you information about the damage you have suffered or dealt.[/p][p]Now you have a brief overview of what the different user interfaces mean and what information they provide.[/p][p]If you want to support the development and me, feel free to check out Ko-Fi Of Irm. Every Thursday, there are behind-the-scenes updates with information on the development status, posts about the lore in the game, and discounts in the Shop Of Irm, where you can purchase stickers![/p][p]I wish you a great week![/p][p]Take care[/p][p]David ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p]

notes.title: Demo Overview
notes.content: [h2]Hey and Hallo![/h2][p]Welcome to a new week! Today, I would like to give you a brief overview of what you can expect in the new demo for Crystals Of Irm. Let's go![/p][list][*][p][b]Miris [/b]- You will be able to visit the city's forecourt. There you will find various merchants and some quest givers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Labyrinth Dungeon[/b] - A core element of the game are the dungeon crawl passages. That's why there is a labyrinth dungeon. This creates new dungeon crawls from a pool of levels, where you can find loot and level up your group. You might even find a strange level or two during your exploration. Who knows![/p][/*][*][p][b]Exploration Areas[/b] - There are various areas around Miris that you can visit in first-person. Two of them will be available in the demo: the river area and the street camp. Here you can complete quests and explore the area on your own. There was already a separate post about the river area. You can find out for yourself what awaits you in the road camp at the end of August.[/p][/*][*][p][b]POIs [/b]- In addition to the large exploration areas, there are small points of interest scattered across the map. There are various things to do here. Sometimes your heroes can search the area, or you can go fishing if you have a fishing rod with you.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battles [/b]- Another core element of the game are the bullet hell battles. Various groups of enemies await you, ready to make your life difficult with their bullet hell patterns. In the dungeons, you will encounter other types of enemies, such as those found on the Ondrion plain.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quests [/b]- Of course, no RPG would be complete without quests. In the demo, a guard will ask you to make your way to the river area. In addition, the herbalists of Miris are always looking for medicinal herbs.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/24ffed7eea467ee762d282adfb4692a5b20218eb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/0fe88f1744ee6a5eea717418b69eb55fa374798f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/1bd6a729e740d890ba34254cd125383f382878db.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/771da650bf3066acc12b22291a7a62d4e2550fbd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/2796dbbb0b7aa00dbdebfd2e98a0b726ae344ca8.png"][/img][/carousel][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/8e9abff3924170ea1cb7e38bbd9d2edeaf613bca.png"][/img][/p][p]These are a few of the core elements you can experience in the demo. Of course, you will also be able to equip and level up your group and experience new runs in the labyrinth dungeons, so you can spend some time with the game.[/p][p]I am really looking forward to finally presenting the work of the last few months, or rather the last 1.5 years, to you![/p][p]Have a good one[/p][p]David ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p]

notes.title: River Area
notes.content: [h2]Hey and Hallo![/h2][p]A new week is beginning in Irm, last week's bugs have been fixed, and it's time to get started on new tasks. This week, I'll be working on the background music and making sure it plays reliably. It already works quite well in 90% of cases, but it can be simplified a little more and made more flexible - that's what I'll be spending my afternoon on. After that, I'll continue working on the exploration areas. One of them is the river area, which I'd like to show you in more detail today.[/p][p]You can enter areas like this via the overworld, and they are scattered all over Irm. Here you can complete quests, find items, and of course, discover a surprise or two.[/p][p]For example, the herbalist in Miris asks you to search for healing leaves. These grow particularly well near watercourses, so you're sure to find some in this area.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/3daa5aa5eb8a2ddd695e900e84b9721d628c0848.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/acae54fa84fe290b0f6b294ea4aedb7c47ce6e0d.png"][/img][/p][p]For the blacksmiths of Miris, it has become too dangerous to operate the mines in the surrounding area, so they are happy for every lump of ore you bring them from your travels. But you won't be able to break it out of the rock without tools.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/e3556fa62499cba38cb450fab8e1d18ddb2263af.png"][/img][/p][p]There is also an old excavation site of the blue magicians, which is sealed shut by powerful spells. However, the spell has not been reinforced for a long time... who knows if it has survived the passage of time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/497c0a25dd3a6187fc35c93b3d9679231e5ed987.png"][/img][/p][p]That was a brief overview of what you can discover in the river area. Places like this are scattered all over Irm, waiting to be explored by you![/p][p]That concludes this week's update. If you want to support me and the development of Crystals Of Irm, feel free to check out the Ko-Fi page. [/p][p][url="https://ko-fi.com/crystalsofirm" style="button" buttoncolor="#d03ec4"]Ko-Fi Of Irm[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/d9235d5b94033e12aa6efcea3d5f24a5ad9c11d6.png"][/img][/p][p]Have a great week! [/p][p]David ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p]

notes.title: New UI & Buttons Buttons Buttons..
notes.content: [h3][b]Hey and hello [/b][/h3][p]Let's start a new week! There's a lot to do this week. On the one hand, there are a few small bugs waiting for me in Crystals Of Irm. The good thing is that most of the bugs relate to the UI redesign. With the new UI, I've tweaked and improved some minor details in the code, which is why some minor things no longer work. These are mainly great things like button graphics that are still way too big, buttons that aren't displayed, or buttons that simply can't be selected anymore! Damn buttons![/p][p]Have you seen the new UI yet? Take a look here![/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/40bb8cee8abd4771f6c6b5f67cf6a1c33e2cbafd.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/eea9b28a4484b2a7cf0b5e318a38e450d80ddb1c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/1e8c55ed3e928f6324e79457f2ab46db43584d65.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/ba4ec357020a3b59f44b5f1ff5feb92c6c38112a.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]Another thing that happened last weekend – I opened the Shop Of Irm – you can access it directly via the Ko-Fi page! There you can find stickers, zines, and other items. We're starting with holographic stickers featuring the three heroes. The character artwork is by the amazing [url="https://ko-fi.com/sabbi_tabbi"]Sabaku[/url] – be sure to check out her work![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="-1TxQvolwBs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]More items will be added in the coming weeks, so it's worth checking back often! With the Hero and Legend Membership, you also get discounts on your purchases in the Shop Of Irm![/p][p]In addition to these things, I'm knee-deep in bureaucracy so that I can work full-time on Crystals Of Irm for the next 6 months. Keep your fingers crossed that it works out![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/d9235d5b94033e12aa6efcea3d5f24a5ad9c11d6.png"][/img][url="https://ko-fi.com/crystalsofirm" style="button" buttoncolor="#fb37a9"]Crystals Of Irm Ko-Fi[/url][/p][p]In the middle of the week, there will be an exclusive post for supporters on the Ko-Fi page![/p][p]Have a great week[/p][p]David ːlunar2019piginablanketː[/p]

notes.title: It's been a while
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey and Hallo![/b][/h2]

uppppss... this time it's been a really long time since the last post. 1 year to be exact, but here I am again and Crystals Of Irm is doing better than ever. I've used the year to really polish all aspects of the game and focus on what makes the game for me. The expansion of the game world and the addition of playable content took up most of my time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/f06823cf32fe3b8c977b6bf48c98472f50e2d850.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/1f38c99862df21b4025cc7bc0e73ec58de4ca4e2.png[/img]

[h3][b]What happened during the year?[/b][/h3]

In addition to the things already mentioned, I took another close look at the gameloop and adapted it so that all parts of the country now have to be traveled and there is something to do everywhere.  In addition to the three large dungeons, there are now entrances to the Labyrinth of Irm. This labyrinth stretches across the entire land and can be entered via various locations. In the labyrinth you can expect randomly arranged “mini-dungeons” in which you can find loot, defeat enemies and find one or two secrets. All in all, the dungeon crawl element is now really present in the game loop and the “mini-dungeons” offer a nice change of pace if you don't want to follow the main quest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/1d83c4fc420a65426fd5362b253e63503836af7f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/49bf9254059a3637fce69fe65385a5fda3a9a31b.png[/img]

[h3][b]What happens from now on?[/b][/h3]

As I've mentioned before, I'm going to try to write a few words about the state of development once a month. I'd also like to make some devlog videos, but I'm finding it quite difficult to do so - it's probably the time involved and the language barrier. So please bear with me if these updates take a little longer!

Apart from that: I'm still planning something that will allow you to directly support my game dev journey - I'll let you know what that looks like in detail soon!

What helps best so far and what is also super simple for you is to click on Wishlist on the Crystals Of Irm Steam page. And if you have any questions or just want to say hello - Feel free to join the Crystals Of Irm Discord

[url=https://discord.gg/zYxNSK7a2n][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/8f9da0adf26bd708a1f009e0114fe83c3206d0eb.png[/img][/url]

That's it from me - Take care

David

notes.title: December Update 2022
notes.content:
[h1]Hey & Hello!
[/h1]

And already it is December again. That was a fast one. You probably guessed it and how could it be otherwise, a lot has happened at Crystals Of Irm. We have really achieved a lot this year and I am already looking forward to 2023. In February there will be a small (actually very big) surprise and I am already so excited. But first things first - the last BlogPost of the year.

What else happened this year? Recently Crystals Of Irm was voted among the TOP100 upcoming Indie Games on IndieDB. How great and a thousand thanks to all who voted for it.

[url=https://www.indiedb.com/groups/2022-indie-of-the-year-awards/top100]IndieDB - Indie of the Year awards TOP 100[/url]


It sounds great! The soundtrack of the game is taking more and more shape and Irm already sounds absolutely wonderful. Just listen to the main theme... It's awesome! Responsible for this great work is the good Fauni. At this point I recommend you to have a look at his site.

[url=https://soundcloud.com/fauni_music]Fauni Soundcloud[/url]

It looks great! Maybe you already noticed the great promo art of Crystals Of Irm. The incredibly talented Saboowas responsible for that. She managed to fill the character with life and I couldn't be happier with the result. Be sure to check out her work as well.

[url=https://www.tumblr.com/sabbitabbi/700675114485907456/its-me-meet-me-at-ko-fi-twitter-cohost?source=share]Sabbi Tabbi Tumblr[/url]

It's playable! Dungeon, villages and demons (ok, not really those) - but things can be explored in Irm now. And I'm working on an extra version for you, so you can finally take a first look into the world of Irm. And it really won't take long this time, I promise. February 2023 will be great and very very exciting. Keep your eyes open.

At this point I could tell you a thousand little things. Things like - the dungeons are completely reworked, the enemies got a make over or there is now an extra section in Irm - just for you to test. But so shortly before the vacation and the celebration I spare you all these details and would suggest that we see each other again at this point in the new year.

Once again, thank you to everyone who supports and believes in me on this project. It really means the world to me and as always, I can't wait for the next steps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/3145fb638789fd7f8487b6031e98c6c661d74a3d.png[/img]

See you next year - Take care

David

notes.title: Crystals Of Irm landed on Steam
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey and Hello![/b][/h1]

[b]Crystals Of Irm[/b] finally made it to Steam! And you already found it - Amazing!

My name is David and I've been working on Crystals Of Irm for a little over two years now. A lot has been done, but there is still a lot to do. Of course I can't do everything alone and I'm lucky to have people by my side who support me with questions, music or playtests. And now let’s starts with today's blog post

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43075143/3145fb638789fd7f8487b6031e98c6c661d74a3d.png[/img]

[h2][b]What is Crystals Of Irm actually?[/b][/h2]

Do you remember the First Person RPGs from long forgotten times? Might & Magic or Eyes of the Beholder? For me these games always offered an exciting mix between gameplay and exploring and experiencing an unique world. So I started to build my very own First Person RPG and here we are. However, I try to pack the whole thing feasible and in a small but fine overall package, with the focus on gameplay. That's how the battle system came about - fast and with fun variations. I will tell you more from Irm in the coming weeks! So it is worth it to take a look in the coming blog posts.

[h2][b]Mini FAQ[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] What is an Irm? - Irm is the name of the land you will travel in the game.
[*] How long will the game be? - Don't expect a 100 hour epic, as the game is mainly developed by one person.
[*]  Will there be loot? - Of course, big loot, small loot, valuable loot, useless loot, round or square loot.
[*] Can I level up my heroes? - Of course, each of the three classes has their own skills and items they can use.
[*] Will I be able to visit different levels?- Your journey will take you through the different lands of Irm and explore different dungeons.
[/list]

[h2][b]What's next?[/b][/h2]
